subject: Evaluation greenlight criteria + keystone checks — MAP draft and next steps
messages:
From: Sam Irwin <sam.irwin@averyhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@averyhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial scoping — evaluation requirements and timeline

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the demo last week. We need a clear mutual action plan (MAP) and objective acceptance tests before our compliance and platform teams greenlight a 6-week pilot. High level asks from Avery Health: 

- Performance: 95th pct latency below 150ms for standard 256-token generation workload; sustained throughput >= 100 req/s under realistic concurrency.
- Quality: entity extraction F1 >= 0.92 on our 200-sample golden set; hallucination rate < 3% (measured on the same set).
- Cost: average per-thousand-token unit cost to be communicated before pilot; we need an estimated monthly spend cap for the pilot.
- Security/Privacy: data retention policy (30 days), audit log access, SOC2 evidence for hosted endpoints.

We attached the latest RFP excerpt for the evaluation criteria. Can your team propose concrete tests and an owner for each gate? We aim to start the pilot the week of Oct 4, pending signoff.

Attachments: AVERY_RFP_v3.pdf

– Sam
Senior Procurement Manager, Avery Health

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Sam Irwin <sam.irwin@averyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial scoping — evaluation requirements and timeline

Sam — thanks, this is exactly the level of detail we need. I attached a working MAP spreadsheet (20260920_MAP-draft.xlsx) with proposed keystone checks and owners. High-level summary below and next steps: 

1) Keystone checks (must pass for greenlight):
   - Smoke performance: simple load run (30m, 100 concurrent users) with p95 < 180ms — owner: Karthik
   - Regression quality: run Avery golden set through our eval harness; target F1 >= 0.92 — owner: Marissa
   - Hallucination audit: manual review of a 200-sample subset, <3% tolerance — owner: Avery / joint review
   - Security attestation: provide SOC2 summary + retention SLA doc — owner: Security (Redwood)

2) Canary plan: 7-day canary under dedicated capacity with telemetry and rollback triggers. If any keystone check fails, we enter a remediation loop and freeze cutover.

3) Cost guardrail: a soft cap and alerts; we'll provide an estimated spend before pilot.

Can you/your security lead confirm the SOC2 artifacts you need? If OK, we'll lock the MAP and circulate a DocuSign sign-off link. Proposed kickoff Zoom: Monday Oct 4, 10am PT.

Attachments: 20260920_MAP-draft.xlsx

— Logan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Irwin <sam.irwin@averyhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial scoping — evaluation requirements and timeline

Adding a couple of practical acceptance tests to the MAP draft: 

- Cache correctness: run 500 prefix-replay tests against the KV cache to ensure determinism for the same seed prompts (owner: Karthik).
- Cache hit ratio target: > 40% for a 1-week synthetic run (owner: Redwood ops).
- Unit-economics gate: per-1k-token cost <= $X (we'll calculate and add to sheet). If exceeded by >15%, trigger negotiation/rollback.

I'll also add a short runbook for the eval timeframe (who runs the harness, where logs land, escalation paths). Karthik — can you add the exact perf-test commands in the sheet?

— Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Irwin <sam.irwin@averyhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial scoping — evaluation requirements and timeline

Thanks — added technical specifics. Key items I put in the perf appendix (perf-test-command-list.sh attached as a stub):

- Smoke command: ./perf_runner --concurrency 100 --duration 1800 --model rdx-compat --tokens 256 --metric p95_latency
  Expected: p95_latency < 180ms on dedicated A100-equivalent instance.
- Load ramp: 0 -> 150 req/s over 20 minutes; sustained 100 req/s for 1 hour for throughput validation.
- Regression harness: ./eval_harness --golden-set avery_200.json --metrics entity_f1,hallucination_rate,topk_precision
  Expected: entity_f1 >= 0.92; hallucination_rate < 3%.
- Canary observability checks: error_rate < 1%, CPU/GPU throttling absent, KV cache hit ratio > 40%.

Greenlight condition: all smoke and regression checks pass + one-week canary with no critical incidents. If smoke fails, we fail-fast and schedule a remediation sprint (owners and SLA in sheet).

Attachment: perf-test-command-list.sh

— Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sam Irwin <sam.irwin@averyhealth.com>

Subject: Re: MAP draft — acceptance tests and timing

Logan/Marissa/Karthik — this looks good and aligns with our internal checklist. A few clarifications before sign-off: 

- SOC2: we need the SOC2 Type II summary and a copy of the control matrix; our security team will confirm if that's sufficient.
- Audit logs: prefer S3 export for the pilot timeframe; include retention controls.
- Test window: we propose Oct 4–Nov 14 pilot (6 weeks) with a 7-day canary Oct 4–Oct 10.

Please send the final MAP as a signer-ready DocuSign and we'll have procurement sign the mutual action plan. HubSpot shows deal HS-48291.

– Sam

Thanks — attaching MAP_v1.0.xlsx and will send the DocuSign envelope this afternoon. Confirmed kickoff call: Oct 4, 10am PT (calendar invite to follow).

Action owners (short):
- Perf smoke + ramp tests: Karthik (Redwood) — target week of Sep 28 for preparatory run.
- Regression suite + golden-set evaluation: Marissa (Redwood) — deliverables: run results + report by Sep 30.
- SOC2 + evidence: Redwood Security — expected artifacts delivered Oct 1.
- Procurement/Signoff: Sam/Procurement (Avery) — sign DocuSign by Oct 1 to hit Oct 4 start.

We've captured rollback triggers and cost guardrails in the MAP spreadsheet. If we get the sign-off by Oct 1 we'll proceed with provisioning dedicated capacity for the canary.
